title: nf-core/hlarnaseq pipeline - params.rna_samples schema
description: Schema for the RNA samples manifest provided with params.rna_samples

rna_sample_id.errorMessage: RNA sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

genome_sample_id.errorMessage: Genome sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

star_bam_path.errorMessage: STAR BAM path must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam'

featurecounts_path.errorMessage: featureCounts path must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.txt', '.tsv' or '.csv'

unmapped_fastq_r1.errorMessage: Unmapped read 1 FastQ file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

unmapped_fastq_r2.errorMessage: Unmapped read 2 FastQ file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
